summary: core-services-watchdog.sh no longer trusts a live Gateway process alone: after a 60 s grace and two consecutive observations with port 18789 closed, it stops that exact PID (TERM, bounded wait, KILL) and restarts it through gateway-start.sh, under the existing repair lease.
reason: S24 01/11 (read only): a Gateway whose in-process start or restart fails can stay alive without a server (« Process will stay alive », port closed, lock released), on 2026.9.6 during a restart and on 2026.10.9 at first start. Only the Companion watchdog recovered it; the core-services watchdog saw pgrep and believed it alive, and the health manager opens an incident without restarting (owner companion). With the Companion stopped, nobody restarted the Gateway.

tests.name: installer/termux-lite/test-core-services-watchdog.sh
tests.evidence: Real processes and a real TCP listener in an isolated HOME: alive + port open = nothing; alive + port closed within the 60 s grace = nothing; one observation beyond grace = logged only; two observations = exact PID stopped by TERM, gateway-start.sh run once, lease released, shell decoy and Companion untouched; TERM ignored = KILL after the bounded wait; deploy lock held, Companion repair lease held, QA campaign shared lock or Tier0 emergency stop = deferred, nothing stopped. Registered in .github/workflows/ci.yml.

tests.evidence: The new test is registered in the CI workflow.

capabilities.reason: Internal supervision of the existing Gateway start path; no route, setting or app action.

architecture.reason: Same watchdog owner, same gateway-start.sh path, same runtime_mode.py lease and companion-deploy.lock; no new store, daemon, scheduler or retry engine.

limitations: Full canonical CI on the final GitHub head remains required.
On the S24 (01/11) core-services-watchdog.sh is not started by any active owner (no process, last log 2026-10-07); the repair takes effect only once an existing owner launches it.

The Companion test harness gets no live-process/closed-port case: its existing-gateway grace is a fixed 30 s constant and process discovery uses the global ps -ef with real signals, so adding it would require a production change in the Companion.
rollback: Revert this commit and redeploy the core.
